the problem of finding the volume of a convex polyhedron defined by a linear inequality system The polyhedron is assumed to be bounded and to have no holes in its boundary The polyhedron can be described by a system of inequalities, which is equivalent to a system of linear inequalities, or by a finite number of linear inequalities The problem is solved by summing the volumes (or areas) of stmphces (or paralleleplpods) which can be fit within the polyhedron

the following two problems (1) Given a set of linear inequalities which define a convex polyhedron, find the volume of the polyhedron (2) Given a set (of linear inequalities which define an arbitrary polyhedron, determine whether the polyhedron is convex or not In this thesis, we present two algorithms for solving the first problem, and a method for solving the second problem.
